query: How do I Create An Email Signature?
ground_truth: KB0000024: Open a new message, go to Message > Signature > Signatures, click New, name it, enter and format your signature, then click OK; the new or edited signature won't appear in the currently open message and must be inserted.

query: How do I quit an application that isn't responding?
ground_truth: KB0000013: On Mac OS X, use Apple menu > Force Quit..., select the app, and click Force Quit; or press Command-Option-Esc. Force quitting won't save latest changes.

query: Can I upgrade my operating system? What are the system requirements?

query: Are Copyrighted Files Illegal to Have On My Computer?
ground_truth: KB0000009: It is legal only if the material is in the public domain, you have permission from the copyright holder, or fair use applies; otherwise unauthorized downloading/sharing may be infringement. Even legally obtained copies must be protected from unauthorized copying by others.
